verses.en: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
verses.pt: É necessário gloriar-me, embora não convenha; mas passarei a visões e revelações do Senhor.
verses.en_web: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast. For I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: As it is necessary for me to take glory to myself, though it is not a good thing, I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

verses.en: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.
verses.pt: Conheço um homem em Cristo que há catorze anos (se no corpo não sei, se fora do corpo não sei; Deus o sabe) foi arrebatado até o terceiro céu.
verses.en_web: I know a man in Christ, fourteen years ago (whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows), such a one caught up into the third heaven.
verses.en_bbe: I have knowledge of a man in Christ, fourteen years back (if he was in the body, or out of the body, I am not able to say, but God only), who was taken up to the third heaven.

verses.en: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)
verses.pt: Sim, conheço o tal homem (se no corpo, se fora do corpo, não sei: Deus o sabe),
verses.en_web: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),
verses.en_bbe: And I have knowledge of such a man (if he was in the body, or out of the body, I am not able to say, but God only),

verses.en: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
verses.pt: que foi arrebatado ao paraíso, e ouviu palavras inefáveis, as quais não é lícito ao homem referir.
verses.en_web: how he was caught up into Paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
verses.en_bbe: How he was taken up into Paradise, and words came to his ears which may not be said, and which man is not able to say.

verses.en: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.
verses.pt: Desse tal me gloriarei, mas de mim mesmo não me gloriarei, senão nas minhas fraquezas.
verses.en_web: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.
verses.en_bbe: On account of such a one I will have glory: for myself I will take no glory, but only in my feeble body.

verses.en: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.
verses.pt: Pois, se quiser gloriar-me, não serei insensato, porque direi a verdade;
verses.en_web: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me, or hears from me.
verses.en_bbe: For if I had a desire to take credit to myself, it would not be foolish, for I would be saying what is true: but I will not, for fear that I might seem to any man more than he sees me to be, or has word from me that I am.

verses.en: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
verses.pt: E, para que me não exaltasse demais pela excelência das revelações, foi-me dado um espinho na carne, a saber, um mensageiro de Satanás para me esbofetear, a fim de que eu não me exalte demais;
verses.en_web: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.
verses.en_bbe: And because the revelations were so very great, in order that I might not be overmuch lifted up, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, one sent from Satan to give me pain.

verses.en: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.
verses.pt: acerca do qual três vezes roguei ao Senhor que o afastasse de mim;
verses.en_web: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.
verses.en_bbe: And about this thing I made request to the Lord three times that it might be taken away from me.

verses.en: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
verses.pt: e ele me disse: A minha graça te basta, porque o meu poder se aperfeiçoa na fraqueza. Por isso, de boa vontade antes me gloriarei nas minhas fraquezas, a fim de que repouse sobre mim o poder de Cristo.
verses.en_web: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to me, My grace is enough for you, for my power is made complete in what is feeble. Most gladly, then, will I take pride in my feeble body, so that the power of Christ may be on me.

verses.en: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ’s sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
verses.pt: Pelo que sinto prazer nas fraquezas, nas injúrias, nas necessidades, nas perseguições, nas angústias por amor de Cristo. Porque quando estou fraco, então é que sou forte.
verses.en_web: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.
verses.en_bbe: So I take pleasure in being feeble, in unkind words, in needs, in cruel attacks, in troubles, on account of Christ: for when I am feeble, then am I strong.

verses.en: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.
verses.pt: Tornei-me insensato; vós a isso me obrigastes; porque eu devia ser louvado por vós, visto que em nada fui inferior aos demais excelentes apóstolos, ainda que nada sou.
verses.en_web: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for in nothing was I inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.
verses.en_bbe: I have been forced by you to become foolish, though it was right for my praise to have come from you: for in no way was I less than the chief of the Apostles, though I am nothing.

verses.en: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.
verses.pt: Os sinais do meu apostolado foram, de fato, operados entre vós com toda a paciência, por sinais, prodígios e milagres.
verses.en_web: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.
verses.en_bbe: Truly the signs of an Apostle were done among you in quiet strength, with wonders and acts of power.

verses.en: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.
verses.pt: Pois, em que fostes feitos inferiores às outras igrejas, a não ser nisto, que eu mesmo vos não fui pesado? Perdoai-me esta injustiça.
verses.en_web: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong.
verses.en_bbe: For what is there in which you were made less than the other churches, but in the one thing that I was not a trouble to you? Let me have forgiveness for this wrong.

verses.en: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
verses.pt: Eis que pela terceira vez estou pronto a ir ter convosco, e não vos serei pesado, porque não busco o que é vosso, mas sim a vós; pois não são os filhos que devem entesourar para os pais, mas os pais para os filhos.
verses.en_web: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
verses.en_bbe: This is now the third time that I am ready to come to you; and I will not be a trouble to you: my desire is for you, not for your property: for it is not the children's business to make store for their fathers, but the fathers for the children.

verses.en: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.
verses.pt: Eu de muito boa vontade gastarei, e me deixarei gastar pelas vossas almas. Se mais abundantemente vos amo, serei menos amado?
verses.en_web: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
verses.en_bbe: And I will gladly give all I have for your souls. If I have the more love for you, am I to be loved the less?

verses.en: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.
verses.pt: Mas seja assim; eu não vos fui pesado; mas, sendo astuto, vos tomei com dolo.
verses.en_web: But be it so, I did not myself burden you. But, being crafty, I caught you with deception.
verses.en_bbe: But let it be so, that I was not a trouble to you myself; but (someone may say) being false, I took you with deceit.

verses.en: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?
verses.pt: Porventura vos explorei por algum daqueles que vos enviei?
verses.en_web: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of them whom I have sent to you?
verses.en_bbe: Did I make a profit out of you by any of those whom I sent to you?

verses.en: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?
verses.pt: Exortei a Tito, e enviei com ele o irmão. Porventura Tito vos explorou? Não andamos porventura no mesmo espírito? Não seguimos as mesmas pegadas?
verses.en_web: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?
verses.en_bbe: I gave orders to Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus make any profit out of you? were we not guided by the same Spirit, in the same ways?

verses.en: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.
verses.pt: Há muito, de certo, pensais que nos estamos desculpando convosco. Perante Deus, falamos em Cristo, e tudo isto, amados, é para vossa edificação.
verses.en_web: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.
verses.en_bbe: It may seem to you that all this time we have been attempting to put ourselves in the right; but we are saying these things before God in Christ. For all things, dear brothers, are for your profit.

verses.en: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:
verses.pt: Porque temo que, quando chegar, não vos ache quais eu vos quero, e que eu seja achado por vós qual não me quereis; que de algum modo haja contendas, invejas, iras, porfias, detrações, mexericos, orgulhos, tumultos;
verses.en_web: For I am afraid that by any means, when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire; that by any means there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, riots;
verses.en_bbe: For I have a fear that, when I come, you may not be answering to my desire, and that I may not be answering to yours; that there may be fighting, hate, angry feeling, divisions, evil talk about others, secrets, thoughts of pride, outbursts against authority;

verses.en: And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.
verses.pt: e que, quando for outra vez, o meu Deus me humilhe perante vós, e chore eu sobre muitos daqueles que dantes pecaram, e ainda não se arrependeram da impureza, prostituição e lascívia que cometeram.
verses.en_web: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness and sexual immorality and lustfulness which they committed.
verses.en_bbe: And that when I come again, my God may put me to shame among you, and I may have grief for those who have done wrong before and have had no regret for their unclean ways, and for the evil desires of the flesh to which they have given way.
